description: A shirtless man in a loincloth kneels in a dark forest with fire glowing in the background, swinging a stone hammer onto a chisel set against a tall, upright stone slab. The slab's face is covered in worn, carved relief that looks like glyphs or figures, with no legible characters. The setting is rough and natural, with rocks and foliage on the ground. The frame is edge to edge with no border.
